implementation_notes: Implementation via task-work delegation. Files planned: 0, Files actual: 0
requirements_addressed: AC-001: Three-step runbook persistence with ordered steps
AC-002: Round-trip preservation of all runbook fields

completion_promises.criterion_text: Creating a three-step runbook persists it under its runbook_id with all three steps in original order; the call reports success
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented create_runbook() with BEGIN IMMEDIATE transactional INSERT of runbook row and all step rows; test_create_three_step_runbook_persists_all_steps_in_order verifies all 3 steps persist in correct order

completion_promises.criterion_text: load_runbook returns the same target, created_at, resume pointer, and overall status that were stored; steps come back in sequence order
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented load_runbook() with SELECT ordered by sequence_index ASC; reconstructs Runbook with all fields preserved; test_load_runbook_preserves_all_runbook_fields validates all fields match

completion_promises.criterion_text: A newly created runbook loads back with every step pending and current_step_index == 0
completion_promises.evidence: Round-trip test confirms initial state preservation; test_new_runbook_has_pending_steps_and_zero_index creates runbook with pending steps and index 0, loads it back, verifies all steps pending and index 0

completion_promises.criterion_text: A single-step runbook round-trips and its pointer rests on the only step
completion_promises.evidence: Boundary test for single-step case; test_single_step_runbook_round_trips creates 1-step runbook with index 0, verifies load returns 1 step with index 0

completion_promises.criterion_text: Creating a runbook with an empty step list raises RunbookValidationError and persists nothing
completion_promises.evidence: Runbook model __post_init__ validates non-empty steps tuple (ASSUM-002); test_empty_step_list_raises_validation_error confirms validation prevents construction and DB count remains 0

completion_promises.criterion_text: A second create_runbook under an existing runbook_id raises RunbookDuplicateError; the original is unaffected
completion_promises.evidence: IntegrityError on PRIMARY KEY violation caught and re-raised as RunbookDuplicateError; _safe_rollback() ensures no partial write; test_duplicate_runbook_id_raises_error verifies error raised and original unchanged

completion_promises.criterion_text: load_runbook for an unknown id returns None
completion_promises.evidence: load_runbook checks if runbook row is None and returns None immediately; test_load_nonexistent_runbook_returns_none verifies None returned for missing runbook

completion_promises.criterion_text: Step params round-trip without loss, including nested mappings
completion_promises.evidence: JSON encoding/decoding via _encode_params()/_decode_params() preserves nested dicts and lists; test_nested_params_round_trip verifies complex nested structure survives round-trip

completion_promises.criterion_text: Steps persisted in a shuffled order still load first-to-last by sequence_index
completion_promises.evidence: load_runbook query includes ORDER BY sequence_index ASC; test_steps_load_in_sequence_order manually inserts steps in reverse order (2,1,0) then verifies load returns them in forward order (0,1,2)

completion_promises.criterion_text: Every public method accepts correlation_id: str explicitly
completion_promises.evidence: Both create_runbook() and load_runbook() signatures include correlation_id: str parameter; used for structured logging; test_create_runbook_accepts_correlation_id and test_load_runbook_accepts_correlation_id verify contract

completion_promises.criterion_text: Seam test passes, proving the repo's INSERT columns match the migration DDL
completion_promises.evidence: test_runbook_schema_matches_repository_writes verifies runbooks/runbook_steps table columns, STRICT mode, and StepStatus CHECK set alignment; pytest -m seam passes

completion_promises.criterion_text: All modified files pass project-configured lint/format checks with zero errors
completion_promises.evidence: ruff check --select E,F,W passes with no errors for both src/forge/persistence/repositories/runbook.py and tests/forge/persistence/test_runbook.py
